components.name: Run Button
components.description: The compact vermilion primary action fixed to the command strip's upper-right action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--vermilion); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-display); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vermilion) 90%, var(--sumi)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--vermilion) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Command Button
components.description: A quiet paper-surface command with a visible shortcut keycap.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--crease); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--sumi); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-display); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sumi) 5%, transparent); transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline kbd { display: inline-flex; min-width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 0.25rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 0.75rem/1 var(--font-display); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Graph Search
components.description: The borderless search field embedded in a full-width creased navigation row.
components.html: <label class="ds-graph-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m20 20-4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search name, value, /path" /></label>
components.css: .ds-graph-search { display: flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--crease); background: var(--sheet); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-display); } .ds-graph-search svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex: none; } .ds-graph-search input { width: min(24rem, 100%); height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; outline: none; background: transparent; color: var(--sumi); font: 400 0.875rem/1 var(--font-display); } .ds-graph-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-graph-search:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--ring); }

components.name: Current Revision Badge
components.description: The restrained-gold status pill that proves which source revision the graph represents.
components.css: .ds-revision { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--gold) 30%, var(--sheet)); color: var(--sumi); font: 500 0.75rem/1.25 var(--font-display); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-revision:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Tabs
components.description: The shared segmented navigation for mobile views and the desktop inspector workbench.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Workbench views"><button class="ds-tab is-active" type="button">Graph</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Inspect</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Result</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); height: 2.25rem; align-items: center; padding: 3px; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-display); } .ds-tab { height: calc(100% - 1px); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--sumi); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-display); transition: color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 65%, transparent); } .ds-tab.is-active { background: var(--background); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sumi) 10%, transparent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Folded Semantic Node
components.description: The signature map object joining semantic identity, exact pointer, role, fold state, and native inline controls for editable primitive values.
components.css: .ds-graph-node { position: relative; min-width: 12rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--crease); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--sumi); box-shadow: 0 7px 18px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sumi) 11%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-display); transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-graph-node::after { position: absolute; right: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; content: ""; clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); border-top: 1px solid var(--crease); border-left: 1px solid var(--crease); background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 48%, var(--sheet-muted) 49%); } .ds-graph-node header, .ds-graph-node footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-graph-node header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--crease); } .ds-graph-node strong { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-graph-node code { display: block; margin-top: 0.125rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.25 var(--font-code); } .ds-graph-node footer { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-node-role { padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--crease); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--sumi); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-graph-node.is-selected { border-color: var(--vermilion); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--vermilion) 18%, transparent), 0 9px 24px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sumi) 13%, transparent); } .ds-graph-node.is-selected::before { position: absolute; top: 0.5rem; bottom: 0.5rem; left: -0.25rem; width: 0.16rem; content: ""; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--vermilion); } .ds-graph-node:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-graph-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Lion Fold Map is a compact developer workbench made from one continuous warm paper field. Its graph, inspector, outline, and result views feel like different folds of the same canonical document rather than detached dashboard cards.

The visual language is precise and tactile: vermilion marks the active sheet and executable actions, sumi carries notation, restrained gold confirms the current revision, and crisp creases separate dense working regions. Expression is concentrated in the folded graph nodes and sheet geometry while controls remain familiar and fast.
keyCharacteristics: Warm washi surfaces with visible creases and sparse paper geometry.
Compact, self-hosted workhorse typography paired with exact monospaced notation.
Vermilion for action and selection; gold only for current-state evidence.
Dense, resizable desktop workbench that becomes a focused tabbed sheet on narrow screens.
Folded semantic nodes reveal exact JSON structure and expose native controls for number, string, and boolean values without leaving the canvas.

rules.name: The Vermilion Means Action Rule
rules.body: Vermilion identifies primary execution, current selection, and direct manipulation; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Gold Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the interface proves currency or active position, never as a second call-to-action color.

rules.name: The Workhorse and Notation Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans Condensed owns interface language; the monospaced stack appears only when the content is structurally exact.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Major work areas meet edge to edge through dividers and resize handles; do not wrap graph, inspector, outline, or result panes in detached dashboard cards.

rules.name: The Focused Fold Rule
rules.body: Wide screens expose the graph beside one focused workbench view; narrow screens preserve the same views as one active full-height tab at a time.

rules.name: The Creases Before Lift Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layers and one-pixel crease borders for structure; add shadow only to global commands or manipulable map objects.

rules.name: The Folded Edge Rule
rules.body: A folded corner belongs to semantic graph nodes and exact-structure states, not to every container in the application.

dos: Do keep graph, inspector, outline, and result visibly connected as folds of one continuous work surface.
Do use vermilion for executable action, selection, focus, and direct graph manipulation.
Do reserve gold for current-revision and active-position evidence.
Do use monospaced type for expression JSON, pointers, ranges, counts, and evaluation output.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, forced-color selection outlines, and coarse-pointer targets.
donts: Don't introduce detached dashboard-card grids around the primary editor panes.
Don't use gold as a decorative accent or competing primary action color.
Don't apply folded corners to generic controls or containers; the fold communicates semantic structure.
Don't reintroduce a persistent text-editor pane; keep exact JSON edits focused on the selected expression.
Don't add decorative shadows where a crease border or tonal sheet change already expresses hierarchy.
